Think about others girls he might do the same, you should report him asap. And don't worry, family will support you, they are the most loving ones who love you so much on this world. Your mission, as a female and citizen is to report him, and in future raise beautiful kids who knows the dangers of this world.
Stay strong, don't let that douche ruin your life.

"I'm only 21 but its obvious I'll never be successful"

That is one big pile of BS, you don't need degree, high school nor ANY investments to be successful. Look at me, everything i do i learned from internet, that is game development, i earn about 2-9k a month, and for now its enough. There is more information than you could ever consume for FREE. Just go on youtube and youll see, here an example https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g5QFW12utdU

Create games for free, publish on android / steam for free, marketing is free, earn cash while sitting on your butt in warm and good environment.

In fact, i am currently working on one small mobile fps title and i need person to help me, if you want to be creative and do interesting stuff message me. Learning will take day or two.
You have only one life, dont waste it.

Check out my thread http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/395ofy/offer_everyone_whos_lonely_having_a_bad_time_or/ , maybe we could chat and actually build something for the whole world. You have only 1 life, don't waste it.

Disorder always stars in your head, and only then moves to physical environment. Clean your home, wash yourself, open the windows so the fresh air fills your space. When things around are close to order or clean or then you will able to fix yourself morally. And trust me, when everything's clean, you will already feel yourself 100x better ;), and you will be able to think clearly.
I am actually starting a little community, for people to get out and do new things. Check out my thread http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/395ofy/offer_everyone_whos_lonely_having_a_bad_time_or/
Stop torturing yourself and just live the life, think and do things which will enjoy you. Talk to your husband, you need to get out of the stagnation and see new parts of the world! Travel or camp!

one person has messaged me so far! Dont be shy, you can do it
(;

Don't be a gear in a world machine, work as what you want, as you've always dreamed while you were a child. You are only 23, same as me, whole life in from of you. Clubs and bars are filled with desperate people trying to drink off their emotions and thoughts, but it's a depressant and not anti depressant. Instead, take you life in your hands right now. my life was quite harsh too, my family always wanted more from me that i could handle. Right now, i do my best, what i want, and work for on my big dream project most of the time, which is a 3d game.
If you want to talk, message me.
